name: empty text is vague
spec_quote: True when no word is left (an empty or blank text is vague).

name: blank whitespace text is vague
spec_quote: True when no word is left (an empty or blank text is vague).

name: canonical vague line
text: Read the email and act — see the link
spec_quote: Examples: "Read the email and act — see the link" → True

name: all filler words plus punctuation dropped
text: Please check the email and respond accordingly!
spec_quote: drop these filler words: read open check see the a an email mail message link it and act on take action follow instructions in as needed please accordingly respond your to do what asks

name: non-filler word survives
spec_quote: Examples: … "Take the Coderbyte assessment" → False

name: punctuation becomes space but letters survive
spec_quote: replace every character that is not a letter, digit or space by a space, split into words … Otherwise False.

name: rejection ignores tempting action text
subject: Update on your application
body: We regret to inform you that we will not be moving forward. Please do not reply to this email. No action is needed within 3 days.
spec_quote: Kinds Rejection, Confirmation, Other → {"action": "", "deadline": "", "reread": false}, whatever the text says.

name: confirmation ignores a pending request
subject: We received your application
body: Thanks for applying to Northwind Traders. Please complete the candidate survey within 2 days.
spec_quote: Kinds Rejection, Confirmation, Other → {"action": "", "deadline": "", "reread": false}, whatever the text says.

name: other kind ignores scheduling text
subject: Weekly newsletter
body: Your interview is scheduled. Please book a time via Calendly within 3 days.
spec_quote: Kinds Rejection, Confirmation, Other → {"action": "", "deadline": "", "reread": false}, whatever the text says.

name: assessment with named platform, duration in minutes, within N days
subject: HackerRank assessment invitation
body: Hi Joey, please complete the HackerRank assessment. It should take about 90 minutes. Please finish it within 5 days.
expect_action: Complete the HackerRank assessment (90 min) via the link in the email
spec_quote:
Assessment: "Complete the

assessment" + " ()" when a duration is found + " via the link in the email". … = the first "N minutes" / "N mins" / "N min" (→ "N min") … that is NOT directly preceded by the word "within". "within N days" → date + N calendar days.

name: assessment with no platform and duration suppressed by within
subject: Your online assessment
body: Your assessment is ready to take. Please finish it within 2 hours.
expect_action: Complete the online assessment via the link in the email
spec_quote: = the first of these named in subject or body …; else "online". = the first "N minutes" … or "N hours" … that is NOT directly preceded by the word "within". "within N hours" → date + ceil(N/24) days.

name: assessment with month-day, no year, Nov. 12th form
subject: Coderbyte challenge for the Backend role
body: Please complete the Coderbyte assessment by Nov. 12th.
expect_action: Complete the Coderbyte assessment via the link in the email
spec_quote: an explicit date after one of: by · before · no later than · due · deadline · deadline: · expires · expires on · until. Date forms: … "Nov. 12th" … A month-day with no year → the message year, or the next year when that date is before the message date.

name: interview scheduling-tool branch with year rollover
subject: Interview scheduling
body: Please pick a time from the link below, no later than November 12.
expect_action: Book an interview time via the scheduling link in the email
spec_quote: A month-day with no year → the message year, or the next year when that date is before the message date. … the text names a scheduling tool or asks him to pick a time (calendly, goodtime, "schedule", "book a time", "select a time", "pick a time", "time slot") → "Book an interview time via the scheduling link in the email".

name: two explicit dates, earliest on or after message date wins
subject: Interview next steps
body: Please reply with your availability. We need an answer by November 20, and your interview must happen before December 1.
expect_action: Reply with your availability for the interview
spec_quote: Several candidates → the earliest one that is on or after the message date. … else the text asks for availability ("availability", "available times") → "Reply with your availability for the interview".

name: explicit past date ignored, ISO date kept
subject: Interview scheduling
body: Please reply with your availability. The original deadline: 2026-11-12 has passed; the updated deadline: 2026-11-25.
expect_action: Reply with your availability for the interview
spec_quote: Candidates before the message date are ignored. … Date forms: … "2026-11-12".

name: business days deadline skips the weekend
subject: TestGorilla assessment
body: Please complete the TestGorilla assessment within 3 business days.
expect_action: Complete the TestGorilla assessment via the link in the email
spec_quote: "within N business days" → the N-th weekday (Mon–Fri) after date.

name: offer with word-number deadline
subject: Your offer from Northwind
body: We are delighted to extend you an offer. Please respond within seven days.
expect_action: Review the offer and reply to the recruiter
spec_quote: N may be digits or a word one..ten. … Offer: "Review the offer and reply to the recruiter".

name: interview branch one via calendly
subject: Interview invitation
body: Use the Calendly link below to choose a slot that works for you.
expect_action: Book an interview time via the scheduling link in the email
spec_quote: the text names a scheduling tool or asks him to pick a time (calendly, goodtime, "schedule", "book a time", "select a time", "pick a time", "time slot") → "Book an interview time via the scheduling link in the email";

name: interview branch two via availability
subject: Next round
body: Could you share your availability for next week?
expect_action: Reply with your availability for the interview
spec_quote: else the text asks for availability ("availability", "available times") → "Reply with your availability for the interview";

name: interview branch three default confirm
subject: Interview confirmation
body: Looking forward to speaking with you on Thursday.
spec_quote: else → "Reply to confirm the interview".

name: action: please after a greeting is not stripped
subject: I-9 verification
body: Hi Joey, please submit your I-9 verification form as soon as possible.
expect_action: Hi Joey, please submit your I-9 verification form as soon as possible.
spec_quote: remove a leading "please " / "kindly " (case-insensitive; also a "please" that follows a leading greeting is NOT special — only at the start)

name: action: url removed, leading please dropped, trailing colon stripped
subject: Background check
body: Please submit the background check form here: https://forms.example.com/abc
expect_action: Submit the background check form here
spec_quote: Clean it: remove URLs (http… up to the next space), remove a leading "please " / "kindly " …, collapse spaces, strip trailing spaces and a trailing ":" or ",", upper-case the first letter

name: action: long sentence cut at last space before 160
subject: Onboarding tasks
body: Please complete the new hire checklist in the portal: upload your ID, sign the handbook acknowledgement, confirm your direct deposit details, and finish the safety training module.
expect_action: Complete the new hire checklist in the portal: upload your ID, sign the handbook acknowledgement, confirm your direct deposit details, and finish the safety…
spec_quote: upper-case the first letter, and when longer than 160 characters cut at the last space before character 160 and add "…".

name: action: no actionable sentence triggers re-read fallback
subject: Northwind Traders application update: interview feedback, references, and next steps
body: We received your application and will be in touch soon.
expect_action: Open the email "Northwind Traders application update: interview feedback, references, and next s" and do what it asks — not read automatically yet
spec_quote: No such sentence → action = 'Open the email "<subject, first 80 characters>" and do what it asks — not read automatically yet' and reread = true.

name: action: first qualifying sentence with you must
subject: Next steps
body: Hi Joey, thanks for applying to Acme. Your application is moving forward. You must complete the skills profile so we can schedule a call.
expect_action: You must complete the skills profile so we can schedule a call.
spec_quote: the first sentence of the body (sentences end at . ! ? followed by a space, or the end) that asks him to do something: it contains "please", "kindly", "you need to", "you must", "required to", or starts with one of complete, submit, …

name: assessment with N-hour duration form
subject: CodeSignal assessment
body: Your CodeSignal assessment is a 2-hour timed test.
expect_action: Complete the CodeSignal assessment (2 h) via the link in the email
spec_quote: <D> = the first "N minutes" … or "N hours" / "N hour" / "N-hour" (→ "N h") that is NOT directly preceded by the word "within". None → no duration part. … None → "".
